field_contracts.source_snapshots: source snapshots declare source id, type, fixture key, capture time, redaction policy, and terms metadata without importing source providers
field_contracts.event_extractions: event extractions normalize event id, source refs, category, summary, confidence, and freshness state
field_contracts.taxonomy: taxonomy maps provider-neutral event categories, severity labels, and impact dimensions
field_contracts.freshness_policy: freshness policy separates recency decay, stale warnings, and source trust
field_contracts.dedupe_confidence: dedupe/source confidence records canonical ids, duplicate ids, source trust, and confidence values
field_contracts.relevance_scores: relevance scores are deterministic fixture values with explanations
field_contracts.sentiment_impact: sentiment and impact labels are provider-neutral and domain-neutral
field_contracts.prompt_contracts: prompt contracts define allowed fields, redaction rules, and forbidden raw credentials or raw URLs
field_contracts.adapter_clean_skip: adapter boundaries clean-skip when source SDKs, credentials, or live network are absent
